title: Beauty Video Templates for Your Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Browse beauty video templates and swap in the product you already shot. Get a routine ad in minutes, in a tall size you can download for TikTok or Reels.
h1: Beauty Video Templates You Can Recreate
lead: Browse beauty templates and rebuild any of them around the product you already shot. You get a ready ad in minutes.
steps_h2: How to Make a Beauty Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: One product photo becomes a routine clip you can post. The package and the label stay in frame.

steps.d: Add a clear photo of the product, with the cap and the label included. The file still shows that same package.
Choose a beauty template and name the routine; no prompt from scratch. You get a tall clip in 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
Set the voice, add the shade name in captions, and download. The clip has nothing stamped on it.

faq.q: How much does a beauty template video cost?
faq.a: Videos cost 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Failed jobs return credits.

faq.q: Can I use a beauty template without editing experience?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a product photo, choose a style, and check the words before downloading. You do not need video editing skills.

faq.q: Which beauty products fit these templates?
faq.a: Use them for skincare, makeup, haircare, and other personal care products. Change the message and scene to suit each product.

faq.q: Who are beauty video templates for?
faq.a: Beauty shops, small brands, and agencies can use them to make product ads quickly. You only need a clear product photo to start.

faq.q: How do beauty video templates work?
faq.a: Upload your beauty product photo, choose a template, and add what you want said. The tool makes a creator-style video you can download and post.

faq.q: Why use an AI beauty ad instead of filming a creator?
faq.a: You can make beauty ads in minutes without booking a creator or studio. Try several openings or shades from the same product photos.

faq.q: Can I use my own beauty product photos and videos?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your own photos or clips to show the product you sell. Use media you have permission to share.

faq.q: Why start with a beauty video template?
faq.a: A template gives you a ready-made ad structure, so you can spend your time on the product message. Make several versions without starting over.

faq.q: Can I use beauty template videos in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Download the video without a watermark and use it in paid ads, product pages, or client work.

faq.q: Where can I post a beauty template video?
faq.a: Post it on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, or your product page. Choose a video size that fits each placement.

faq.q: What are beauty video ad templates?
faq.a: Beauty video templates give you a ready-made ad with an opening, product scenes, voice, and AI actor. Add your product photo to make it your own.
